package.name: humanoid_interfaces
package.description: The message/action contract shared by every package in this repo: PolicyObservation, JointTargets, JointCommand, RobotState, SafetyStatus (control stack) and Skill, SkillSequence, ObjectPose, ObjectPoseArray (task stack) messages, the ExecuteManipulation action, the canonical 23-DOF joint order, and the machine-readable interface_contract.yaml. See README.md and INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md.
